title: Ko Slumber Haa Wakkati
intro: Miijo-ɗee sahaa nde goonga muumɗi, gooŋɗinɓe njiylotoo. Fedde tokosere suɓii ko ruttaade e dogde, heɓde reentaade e nokkuuji ɓurɗi waasde — nokku mo wonata nokku maɓɓe fooftorde fotde teeminanɗe ɗe limtaaka. Nde ɓe ndartiima, aduna o wayliima e sara maɓɓe. Hol ɓeeɗoo ruuhuuji ɗaaniiɓe?
clues: Min ngonnoo ko sukaaɓe hoɗɓe e wuro ɓooyngo.
Renndo amen ina ɗaɓɓi nde min ndewata e bannge maɓɓe, kono min njaɓaani.
Min ndogi wuro ngo ngam ɗaɓɓude daɗndo e luutndiiɓe ko min ngoongɗini koo.
Sehil am lolluɗo koyɗe nay jooɗii e damal suudu amen cuuɗiiɗo.
Alla waɗi en ɗannondirde duuɓi teemedde tati e jeenay (39).
Nde min njippii e joofnirde, wuro amen ngo meeɗnoo-ɗen torraade ngoo, jaɓii iimanaagal.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Min ndartiima e nder ngaska, min ɗaaniima duuɓi teemedde
Min jarribaama e gelooɗi debbo kaawis
trial.answer: Min ndartiima e nder ngaska, min ɗaaniima duuɓi teemedde

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Ko mbaydi toowndi haa yettii asamaan

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Min ngummii min tawi wuro amen wayliima wonti goonɗinal
Yiite ɓuuɓnge wonti cooyngal e jam
Colli jogiiɗi kaaƴe mbonni gaño oo
Liɗɗi mawɗi njaltini en e daande maayo
outcome.answer: Min ngummii min tawi wuro amen wayliima wonti goonɗinal

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
